title: CLAUDE.md — kelpbio
text: analysis project uses embr/cmdstanr. kelpbio re-implements models using rstan/rstantools (pre-compiled Stan, cmdstan required runtime). Key analysis scripts: kelpbio works site-year resolution — month dimension (analysis models’ month effects dropped). Biomass combines six models via size-integration (density × E_size[weight(diameter)] × ratios), density × weight; see docs/package-design.md §Derived Predictions. wetdry/carbon become intercept-Beta (REs) month dropped.

title: CLAUDE.md — kelpbio
text: Backend: rstan + rstantools. Stan models live inst/stan/ pre-compiled R CMD INSTALL time. cmdstan: users need cmdstanr separate Stan installation. Sampling: rstan::sampling(stanmodels$<name>, data = stan_data, chains = 4, adapt_delta = 0.95, thin = nthin, ...) devtools::load_all() work Stan changes — always use devtools::install(). See docs/bayesian-engine.md full details including Stan file conventions, priors--data pattern, structural flags.

title: CLAUDE.md — kelpbio
text: analysis project Stan models require adaptations kelpbio: Priors data — analysis models hard-code priors; kelpbio passes prior hyperparameters data block users can adjust via kb_priors_*(). Column naming — analysis uses CamelCase (SbulbMax, PlantW, Site, Year); kelpbio uses snake_case (diameter, weight, site, year).

title: CLAUDE.md — kelpbio
text: Access via $: x$draws, x$data, x$meta. samples(x) returns draws container. live stanfit discarded fitting — see docs/package-design.md §Data & model storage. Single package (R-universe, CRAN): demo + coastwide data + slim pre-fit models data/; companion data package.

title: CLAUDE.md — kelpbio
text: Prefix: exported functions use kb_ Validation: exported function arguments validated chk; user-facing messages via cli Documentation: roxygen2 markdown; @inheritParams shared parameters Writing (docs, README, vignettes, roxygen, PR/commit text): follow writing style ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; particular em-dashes en-dashes (use hyphens, commas, colons) mid-sentence bold emphasis; concise technical register File layout: one function per file, file named function (kb_fit_weight() → R/kb_fit_weight.R). S3 methods grouped one file per generic, named generic (R/print.R holds print.* methods, R/tidy.R tidy.*, etc.). Internal helpers clearly-named files, never catch-utils.R. Testing: testthat 3e; strict 1:1 test mirroring (R/<name>.R ↔︎ tests/testthat/test-<name>.R). Test wrapper, model’s numbers. Snapshot print methods + messages; NEVER snapshot MCMC numerics (test structure + invariants instead). Small pre-built fits tests/testthat/fixtures/ (built rstan::sampling(seed=), set.seed); slow end--end fits skip_on_cran(). Factor pure logic (data/prior assembly) fit functions MCMC-free testing. See docs/testing-strategy.md. Code style: tidyverse; lubridate, reshape2, plyr, data.table library() calls package code; use @importFrom pkg::fun() run Stan MCMC session without confirming first; fitting slow
